name: Fuji Masami
source:
Vice President of the PTA. 

She is a very devoted educational mother. She is famous among the teachers for being fussy. 

She is a married woman in her prime.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/yara_syuugaku/chara.html]official site[/url]]
